title: Coatings.
officialText: At the time concrete is placed, reinforcement shall be free from mud, oil or other nonmetallic coatings that decrease bond. Zinc and epoxy-coating of steel reinforcement in accordance with ACI 318, Sections 3.5.3.8, 3.5.3.9, and 3.5.3.10 shall be permitted.
